judged_text: P2: `PollFeed` assumes Atom-style item fields — `i.content.scrub` has no nil guard (RSS 2.0 description-only feeds and Atom entries without `content` yield nil/undefined) and `i.id` assumes Atom (RSS uses `guid`), so common feeds crash the job, and with `sidekiq_options retry: false` the same item fails again every hourly run, permanently disabling feed import despite advertised "RSS or ATOM" support

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the job unconditionally does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`; if `i.content` is `nil` for a feed item, this will raise (e.g., `NoMethodError` on `nil.scrub`) and crash the poll. The URL fallback also assumes `i.id` (`url = i.id if url.blank? || url !~ /^https?\:\/\//`), which may not exist for some RSS items. Since the job has `sidekiq_options retry: false`, a crash won’t be retried by Sidekiq, but the scheduled job will keep failing on subsequent hourly runs, effectively breaking feed import until data/settings change.
